isolated_environment.browser: Windows Chrome 155.0.8059.80 via existing Playwright browser-server adapter
isolated_environment.notification_requests: Zero captured requests in each final lab; synthetic destinations only.
isolated_environment.cleanup: Both final disposable HA labs shut down and removed their temporary configuration and credentials. The newly launched Windows browser server and its Chrome instance were closed; preexisting helpers were retained.

native_navigation_fixture.reason: Native Home Assistant queries diagnostic capabilities for the synthetic lab integration. With no diagnostics platform, Core returns not_found Domain not supported and native HA leaves that rejection unhandled. The final case models only this synthetic-domain capability response using the Core response schema. It does not suppress browser exceptions or alter any Homeostatic request.
native_navigation_fixture.selector_correction: Visibility targets the inner native dialog and visible device-name content because the custom-element hosts have no layout box.
native_navigation_fixture.real_paths: Native HA more-info, Escape dismissal, exact registry-device URL and page content, browser Back, same-issue reopen and unchanged saved settings.
